newsitem.title: USA: Rouge Steel production loss to cut Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Rouge Steel production loss to cut Q4 net.

text.p: Rouge Steel Co said Wednesday that problems with its largest blast furnace have resulted in an unexpected loss of about 50,000 tons of iron production during the month of November.
The loss and its effect on operations are expected to reduce the company's fourth quarter operating income by $5 million, Rouge said.

Rouge said it had recently completed a $35 million reline of the furnace, and it was returned to production on October 28. After completing the reline, the company said it suffered a series of operating problems which resulted in the temporary shutdown of the "C" blast furnace.

"The recent 'C' blast furnace production loss and its impact on downstream operations are expected to reduce the company's operating income in the fourth quarter of 1996 by $5 million," Gary Latendresse, vice president and chief financial officer, said in a news release.
The company said the recovery process has been slow, but the furnace is nearing its expected operating rate.
Rouge Steel provides flat rolled sheet steel to the automotive, converter and service center markets.
